From: Elena Morales <accounts-payable@scandia-retail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@scandia-retail.com
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:14:00 +0000
Subject: Invoice delivery and billing contact — Scandia Retail

Hi Ben,

Quick question from our AP team as we finalize the onboarding checklist: who will appear as the invoice originator (bill-from) and can invoices be delivered into our supplier portal? If not, we need invoices emailed to accounts-payable@scandia-retail.com and copied to finance@scandia-retail.com.

A few specifics they asked for:
- Our PO is SR-4432 — we need a visible PO number on the PDF line items.
- VAT: Scandia is VAT-registered in DE (DE123456789). Do you include VAT registration and VAT breakdown on the invoice?
- File format: PDF is fine; if you support a machine-readable XML/UBL that would be excellent for our AP system.

I'll attach our signed onboarding MSA and our tax cert for your records. Let me know who at Redwood should be our billing contact (name + email) and whether you can push to our portal or if we should expect emailed PDFs.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Accounts Payable Manager
Scandia Retail
attachments: Signed-MSA-Scandia.pdf (pdf), scandia-tax-cert.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 17:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and billing contact — Scandia Retail

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Short answers and next steps below.

Options we support (pick one, we will configure):
1) Portal push (preferred for scale) — we can deliver invoices into your supplier portal via SFTP or API. Need portal credentials / partner ID and preferred filename pattern.
2) Email delivery — PDF to accounts-payable@scandia-retail.com with optional copy to finance@scandia-retail.com.
3) E-invoice (UBL/XML) — we can emit XML/UBL alongside PDF.

VAT: we include VAT registration and line-item tax breakdown by default when you supply the customer VAT ID. If the invoice should be treated as reverse-charge, flag that and provide the legal basis.

Billing contact: please use billing@redwood.ai for automated delivery and cc marissa_cole@redwood.ai for onboarding questions. Our billing owner for this account will be Marissa Cole; Laura is looped for finance approvals (credit terms / PO matching rules).

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm delivery method (portal push / email copy / XML) and whether you require consolidated monthly invoices or individual per-invoice emails.
- If portal: please share partner ID / SFTP host or API contact and an example of the inbound filename you expect.
- If email: confirm if single monthly consolidated file is preferred and if we should include one PDF per invoice or a combined PDF.

I'll let Marissa reply with the SLA for invoice delivery and sample XML we can provide.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Hi all — looping in billing ops details.

We can do any of the three delivery methods Ben outlined. My team prefers portal push for reliability, but we frequently send email copies for systems that require PO matching by human operators. Proposed configuration for Scandia:
- Primary: portal push via SFTP (we will push invoice PDFs to an agreed folder).
- Secondary: email delivery (cc to finance@scandia-retail.com) for 30 days of overlap during cutover.
- File formats: PDF + optional UBL/XML (attached is a sample XML schema we can emit).
- PO matching: we will populate PO number SR-4432 on the invoice header and each line as requested.
- SLA: daily batch push for invoices generated before 21:00 UTC; immediate one-off pushes for credit memos or urgent corrections.

Requirements from Scandia for portal push: partner ID or SFTP credentials + preferred filename pattern (e.g. SCANDIA_SR4432_INV_{YYYYMMDD}_{INVNO}.pdf). If you prefer invoices only once monthly, tell us the cadence and we will consolidate.

I attached a sample invoice XML for your AP team to validate: sample-invoice-xml.xml

If everyone agrees, Ben can confirm and we'll schedule a quick handoff call to collect credentials.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
